title: One Two (Full Album 1982)
summary: I love me some Sister Nancy, the perfect bridge between roots and bashment which brought on the Dancehall. This album will bring smiles to anyone while those who listen will leave with questions about society as well..
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Np1McWG4G8o

I love me some Sister Nancy, the perfect bridge between roots and bashment which brought on the Dancehall.

This  album will bring smiles to anyone while those who listen will leave with questions about society as well..
